description: OMENZ Email Check: is this email address real enough to use? UNDELIVERABLE (bad syntax, no such domain, no mail server) / RISKY (disposable throwaway provider, or a domain with no SPF and no DMARC) / DELIVERABLE_LIKELY. Also: free webmail vs company domain, role account (info@, sales@), plus-addressing and the normalized address. Public DNS only, no SMTP probing, nothing stored. Pairs with Phone Check for leads and signups. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/email/check, $0.002 via x402.)
